A decision shall be taken in the matter at the
earliest but positively within 24 hours from the date of
receipt of the copy of the order.

communicating the order of the Court.
The writ petition stands disposed of.
Urgent certified photocopy of this order, if applied
for, be supplied to the parties expeditiously on
compliance of usual legal formalities.
 
  
Sh                                                                (Amrita Sinha, J.)
